description: usnewsmap.com: respect origin caching for static assets
usnewsmap.com: cache version-qualified lookups, respecting origin no-store
expression: (http.host eq "usnewsmap.com" and any(http.request.uri.args["v"][*] ne "") and (http.request.uri.path in {"/v1/places" "/v1/titles" "/v1/coverage" "/v1/days" "/api/v1/places" "/api/v1/titles" "/api/v1/coverage" "/api/v1/days"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1/titles/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/v1/titles/")))

description: usnewsmap.com: cache searches pinned to a version and generation; the API sends no-store for anything else
expression: (http.host eq "usnewsmap.com" and (any(http.request.uri.args["v"][*] ne "") and any(http.request.uri.args["g"][*] ne "") and http.request.uri.path in {"/v1/aggregate" "/api/v1/aggregate"}))

description: usnewsmap.com: never edge-cache HTML, other searches, live data or cross-origin API calls
expression: (http.host in {"www.usnewsmap.com" "api.usnewsmap.com"} or (http.host eq "usnewsmap.com" and not (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/basemap/") or http.request.uri.path in {"/robots.txt" "/favicon.svg" "/og-image.png"} or (any(http.request.uri.args["v"][*] ne "") and any(http.request.uri.args["g"][*] ne "") and http.request.uri.path in {"/v1/aggregate" "/api/v1/aggregate"}) or (any(http.request.uri.args["v"][*] ne "") and (http.request.uri.path in {"/v1/places" "/v1/titles" "/v1/coverage" "/v1/days" "/api/v1/places" "/api/v1/titles" "/api/v1/coverage" "/api/v1/days"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1/titles/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/v1/titles/"))))))
